chacune des relations
$$\begin{vmatrix} a_{12}b_{13} - a_{13}b_{12} & a_{13}b_{11} - a_{11}b_{13} & a_{11}b_{12} - a_{12}b_{11} \\ a_{22}b_{23} - a_{23}b_{22} & a_{23}b_{21} - a_{21}b_{2?} & a_{21}b_{22} - a_{22}b_{21} \\ a_{32}b_{33} - a_{33}b_{32} & a_{33}b_{31} - a_{31}b_{33} & a_{31}b_{32} - a_{32}b_{31} \end{vmatrix} = 0$$
et
$$\begin{vmatrix} A_{12}B_{13} - A_{13}B_{12} & A_{13}B_{11} - A_{11}B_{13} & A_{11}B_{12} - A_{12}B_{11} \\ A_{22}B_{23} - A_{23}B_{22} & A_{23}B_{21} - A_{21}B_{23} & A_{21}B_{22} - A_{22}B_{21} \\ A_{32}B_{33} - A_{33}B_{22} & A_{33}B_{31} - A_{31}B_{33} & A_{31}B_{32} - A_{32}B_{31} \end{vmatrix} = 0$$
est la conséquence de l'autre. D. ARANT.

2° En particulier, on fera $a + bi = \frac{\rho}{c}(\cos\omega + i\sin\omega)$, puis $c = 0$. De l'identité (1) correspondante, déduire qu'on peut, d'une infinité de manières, satisfaire à l'identité suivante:
$$A_0\cos(2n+1)\omega + A_1\cos\omega\cos 2n\omega + A_2\cos^2\omega\cos(2n-1)\omega + \ldots\ldots + A_{2n+1}\cos^{2n+1}\omega \equiv 0,$$

questions.statement_en:
2° In particular, set $a + bi = \frac{\rho}{c}(\cos\omega + i\sin\omega)$, then $c = 0$. From the corresponding identity (1), deduce that one can, in infinitely many ways, satisfy the following identity:
$$A_0\cos(2n+1)\omega + A_1\cos\omega\cos 2n\omega + A_2\cos^2\omega\cos(2n-1)\omega + \ldots + A_{2n+1}\cos^{2n+1}\omega \equiv 0,$$
where $A_0, A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_{2n+1}$ are independent of $\omega$, and at least $n$ of these quantities are arbitrary.
